question: Does the v1<->v2 surrogate agreement seen in the polish regime extend to the cloud-survival regime?
hypothesis: v1 and v2 admit the same survivor cloud (the polish-regime Spearman 0.996 carries over).

artefacts.caption: 2x2 v1 vs v2 cloud histogram at LC extrema, seed 14

narrative_md: At seed 14's LC extrema (N=500k pool, TOL +/-0.10 mag), v2 admits 78% more cells than v1 at the dim epoch (1980 vs 1113) and IoU(v1,v2) ~ 0.42 at BOTH extrema -- so the survivor SETS differ materially despite the polish-regime Spearman 0.996. Mechanism: the TOL window sits on a near-vertical edge of a heavy-tailed residual distribution, amplifying tiny v1<->v2 shape differences. Load-bearing substrate for the v1-substrate-reframe memory: anywhere a pipeline consumes v1 cloud counts/survivor sets the result is suspect. Renders truth-LC extrema vs mag_hifi (render-at-truth).
